verdict.rationale: Box's own marketing claims users can 'edit, and co-create content' as teams work together, which glancingly asserts in-place collaborative editing. Nothing documents real-time browser co-editing of docs, sheets or slides, either natively or through a named integration. Preview annotation (box-docs-14) is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. missing for 10: documentation of real-time multi-user co-editing, browser editors or a documented integration for docs/sheets/slides, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration

citations.quote: Access, share, edit, and co-create content with AI while accelerating productivity.
as teams work together from anywhere
